# What CI runs for what

Each case of the CI planner's table (`tools/cli/test/ci-plan.cases.json`), with
what a pull request of that change runs. A case of several files planned one at
a time shows its first. [What CI runs](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#what-ci-runs)
explains the rules, and `npm run tools -- ci explain <files>` explains any
change. Every pull request also runs `changes`, `dollarlint`,
`dependency-review`, `advisories` and `ci-ok`.

| Case                                                                                                                            | Example                                                                                                                                 | Runs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Documentation alone runs only the docs job                                                                                      | `README.md`, `docs/guides/host.md`, `packages/renderers/database/README.md`                                                             | `docs`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Markdown a crate embeds or a generator reads or writes runs the Linux checks alone                                              | `docs/reference/cli.md`, and each of the others                                                                                         | `public-product (ubuntu-latest)`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| One renderer's change runs that renderer's harness tests, the suites that bundle every renderer and the package check, on Linux | `packages/renderers/database/src/styles.css`                                                                                            | `public-product (ubuntu-latest)`, `package`; browser: host/core ×3, storybook ×3, renderers/harness ×4, host/inspector ×2, rest (examples/renderers/minimal, cli, host/vscode-ui), 1 on macOS; the harness for database only                                                                                                                                                                           |
| A scenario's extraction is its renderer's change                                                                                | `packages/extractors/tetragon-policies/tests/fixtures/credentials/after.expected.json`                                                  | `public-product (ubuntu-latest)`, `windows`, `windows-node`, `windows-integration`, `package`; browser: host/core ×3, storybook ×3, renderers/harness ×4, host/inspector ×2, rest (examples/renderers/minimal, cli, host/vscode-ui), 1 on macOS; the harness for runtime-policy only                                                                                                                   |
| The kit every renderer uses runs the whole harness                                                                              | `packages/renderers/kit/src/index.ts`                                                                                                   | `public-product (ubuntu-latest)`, `package`; browser: host/core ×3, storybook ×3, renderers/harness ×12, host/inspector ×2, rest (examples/renderers/minimal, cli, host/vscode-ui), 2 on macOS                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| An Engine change runs the Rust, Windows, Verus, coverage and mutation jobs and every browser suite                              | `packages/engine/src/lib.rs`                                                                                                            | `public-product (ubuntu-latest)`, `public-product (macos-latest, Rust)`, `public-product (macos-latest, Node)`, `verus`, `windows`, `windows-node`, `windows-integration`, `package`, `coverage`, `mutants-diff`; browser: host/core ×3, storybook ×3, renderers/harness ×12, host/inspector ×2, rest (examples/renderers/minimal, cli, comparators/runtime/js, engine/js, host/vscode-ui), 2 on macOS |
| An extractor's change runs the Inspector, which extracts, and the CLI's other suites, but not the renderer harness              | `packages/extractors/django-schema/src/lib.rs`                                                                                          | `public-product (ubuntu-latest)`, `public-product (macos-latest, Rust)`, `public-product (macos-latest, Node)`, `windows`, `windows-node`, `windows-integration`, `package`; browser: host/inspector ×2, rest (examples/renderers/minimal, cli)                                                                                                                                                        |
| CI, toolchain, lockfile, tooling and rules changes, and unrecognised files, run every job                                       | `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and each of the others                                                                                      | Everything                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| The ci:full label runs everything                                                                                               | `README.md` (labels ci:full, documentation)                                                                                             | Everything                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Pushes, the nightly run and manual runs run everything                                                                          | no files (push)                                                                                                                         | Everything                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| A file a crate's sources read by path is that crate's change, though no manifest says so                                        | `packages/schemas/fixtures/conformance.json`, and each of the others                                                                    | `public-product (ubuntu-latest)`, `verus`, `windows`, `windows-node`, `windows-integration`, `package`, `coverage`; browser: host/core ×3, storybook ×3, renderers/harness ×12, host/inspector ×2, rest (examples/renderers/minimal, cli, comparators/runtime/js, engine/js, host/vscode-ui), 2 on macOS                                                                                               |
| A file only a crate's tests read runs its suites without changing what depends on it                                            | `packages/schemas/fixtures/conformance.json`                                                                                            | `public-product (ubuntu-latest)`, `verus`, `windows`, `windows-node`, `windows-integration`, `package`, `coverage`; browser: host/core ×3, storybook ×3, renderers/harness ×12, host/inspector ×2, rest (examples/renderers/minimal, cli, comparators/runtime/js, engine/js, host/vscode-ui), 2 on macOS                                                                                               |
| Any file of a crate is a Rust change, and Markdown test data is not documentation                                               | `packages/extractors/github-agentic-workflows/vendor/gh-aw/fields.json`, and each of the others                                         | `public-product (ubuntu-latest)`, `windows`, `windows-node`, `windows-integration`, `package`; browser: host/inspector ×2, rest (examples/renderers/minimal, cli)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
